answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 9 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in ivory, verified in shale, and ferrous names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Every extra alias adds 6 hours of verification and 16 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
